question: Does choosing ready-operation order leave useful headroom over affordable hand dispatch/search?
placement: Fixed affinity plus 64-round single-flip placement descent under original FIFO physics, identical across all ordering arms; its compute cost is charged
dispatch: Globally sort ready operations by declared static operation priority, break ties by job; start each resource-feasible operation and bypass blocked candidates; no preemption; original setup/lock/domain physics
selection: Best calibration mean among start/search controls with p95<=4.25ms, frozen before fresh outcomes
reference: Best frozen control and 8192 priority-swap annealing proposals from spt and srpt; feasible reference, not certified optimum
gate: Fresh median reference gain>=5 percent, positive bootstrap lower bound, control p95<=5ms
live_gate: 32 fresh cases times frozen control, reference and plain srpt =96 real HeROsim simulations; independent priority SimPy replay and every operation completion checked
scope: New ordering seat with fixed placements, no learned policy yet, not an end-to-end joint placement/ordering result; no training unless headroom and representation/control challenges justify it
